summary: Prelude Therapeutics filed an 8-K reporting an underwritten public offering of 18,018,014 common shares at $4.44 per share and pre-funded warrants to purchase 2,252,252 shares at $4.4399 per warrant with a $0.0001 exercise price. The offering was led by new investor RA Capital Management with participation from Soleus Capital and other healthcare investors. Net proceeds of approximately $85.5 million are for general corporate purposes including R&D and working capital. This is a routine capital raise via a shelf registration, not a special situation.
